description: Ministry of Housing & Construction - Amendment Ex. Gaz. No. 2057/05 of 05.02.2018, Construction Development  Act. 33/2014 (S only)
categorisation: This gazette content is a correction notice for regulations made under the Construction Industry Development Act, No. 33 of 2014. It specifically deals with legal/regulatory matters by correcting statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation. The content does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. It is purely a legal/regulatory correction notice.
